posts.title: FCC clears SpaceX to launch 1 million Starmind satellites
posts.excerpt: Musk said he anticipates the first Starmind spacecraft launching in the third quarter of 2027. SpaceX will manufacture the satellites in Bastrop, Texas, about 350 miles north of Starbase.
posts.body: Musk said he anticipates the [first Starmind spacecraft launching in the third quarter of 2027](https://spaceflightnow.com/2026/11/26/fcc-green-lights-spacexs-plan-to-launch-1-million-starmind-data-center-satellites/). SpaceX will manufacture the satellites in Bastrop, Texas, about 350 miles north of Starbase.

posts.title: Minnesota kids' cases move to Houston judge
posts.excerpt: Immigration Judge Jason L. Stern of Houston has taken over juvenile dockets from Minnesota's Fort Snelling court, presiding by video while the children must appear in person. Attorneys told MPR News…
posts.body: [Immigration Judge Jason L. Stern of Houston](https://immigration-analytics.com/2026/11/25/unaccompanied-children-cases-minnesota-houston-judge/) has taken over juvenile dockets from Minnesota's Fort Snelling court, presiding by video while the children must appear in person. Attorneys told MPR News he is setting deadlines a lot faster, with asylum and other applications due in December and January.

posts.title: DeepL launches Aure v2, its fastest voice translation model
posts.excerpt: DeepL launched Aure v2 today, cutting median translation delay by 50% versus its predecessor. The model translates directly from speech to speech, skipping the separate transcription, translation,…
posts.body: [DeepL launched Aure v2 today](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/deepl-introduces-aure-v2-its-fastest-voice-ai-translation-model-302950629.html), cutting median translation delay by 50% versus its predecessor. The model translates directly from speech to speech, skipping the separate transcription, translation, and speech steps.

posts.excerpt: Published Nov 25, 2026, 7:40 PM: JetBrains released Mellum2.1 Instruct, an open coding model that answers without a chain of thought. On agentic coding tasks, it generates about half as many tokens…
posts.body: Published Nov 25, 2026, 7:40 PM: [JetBrains released Mellum2.1 Instruct](https://blog.jetbrains.com/ai/2026/11/mellum2-1-instruct-is-out-bringing-faster-answers-for-coding-agents/), an open coding model that answers without a chain of thought. posts.title: Our Rescue keeps HHS migrant-child legal support contract
posts.excerpt: Published Nov 25, 2026, 5:40 PM: The Government Accountability Office on Monday denied Acacia Center for Justice's protest of HHS's sole-source award for legal representation for unaccompanied…
posts.body: Published Nov 25, 2026, 5:40 PM: The Government Accountability Office on Monday [denied Acacia Center for Justice's protest](https://news.bgov.com/federal-contracting/our-rescue-keeps-hhss-migrant-child-legal-support-contract) of HHS's sole-source award for legal representation for unaccompanied migrant children. Utah-based Our Rescue can move forward with the contract, whose potential length is 18 months.

posts.body: Published Nov 25, 2026, 5:20 PM: [A GTA 6 dump is reportedly running on a jailbroken PS5](https://www.notebookcheck.net/GTA-6-game-dump-runs-on-PS5-console-jailbreak-boosting-piracy-and-PC-emulator.1460007.0.html). posts.title: Wyden calls HHS fraud report bogus
posts.excerpt: Senate Finance ranking member Ron Wyden called HHS's sponsor-fraud report bogus, saying it rested on a sample of less than 2% of sponsor releases. He demanded HHS preserve all records behind the…
posts.body: Senate Finance ranking member Ron Wyden [called HHS's sponsor-fraud report bogus](https://www.finance.senate.gov/ranking-members-news/wyden-slams-bogus-hhs-fraud-report-used-to-justify-stripping-protections-from-unaccompanied-children/), saying it rested on a sample of less than 2% of sponsor releases. He demanded HHS preserve all records behind the report.

posts.title: NoUpdate bypasses PS5 game-update blocks
posts.excerpt: NoUpdate, a new open-source payload from developer Zer0Day, lifts the launch block that stops a game from running after the console detects an available update, so it plays again without the download…
posts.body: [NoUpdate](https://nextgenupdate.com/articles/459/new-ps5-homebrew-tool-noupdate-helps-bypass-game-update-restrictions), a new open-source payload from developer Zer0Day, lifts the launch block that stops a game from running after the console detects an available update, so it plays again without the download or a reinstall. It targets PS5 firmware 6.xx through 13.60, though Zer0Day has confirmed testing only on 10.01 so far.

posts.title: Z.ai says GLM-5.4 thinks like a model four times its size
posts.excerpt: Z.ai released GLM-5.4 on Monday, a 750-billion-parameter model that runs its 28 layers twice instead of stacking more weights. Coding Plan subscribers get 50% more usage than they did with GLM-5.3.
posts.body: [Z.ai released GLM-5.4](https://decrypt.co/383851/chinas-zai-new-ai-model-glm-think-like-four-times-size) on Monday, a 750-billion-parameter model that runs its 28 layers twice instead of stacking more weights. Coding Plan subscribers get 50% more usage than they did with GLM-5.3.
